title: Tanker Big Picture: Mideast state fleet boom?
section_path: Tanker Big Picture: Mideast state fleet boom?
section_path_text: Tanker Big Picture: Mideast state fleet boom?
summary:
Main
By Mary Melton
Where does this leave the independent owners? The dramatic increase in risk in getting crude out of chokepoints in the Middle East has accelerated the dominance of Middle East National Oil Companies in the VLCC sector. All things being equal, this does not bode well for independent owners.
